As the Lead Thumbnail Designer at Knwn Local, you'llbuild and develop a team of 5-10+ thumbnail designers who create scroll-stopping visuals that drive channel growth for America's top real estate leaders. This is aplayer-coach leadership role where you'll spend 60-80% of your time managing, mentoring, and building systems, and 20-40% hands-on designing complex projects.

You'llown design quality standards, team development, and creative operations across the agency, partnering closely with Pod Managers, Creative Director, and leadership on strategic initiatives. Your success is measured not by how many thumbnailsyou design, but by how wellyour team performs, grows, and delivers results that drive client success.

This role is perfect for someone wholoves developing designers as much as designing itself - someone who gets energized by building systems, coaching talent, and multiplying impact through others. If you want to stay purely hands-on without management responsibilities, this isn't the right fit.

Team Leadership & Development (50-70% of role)

  • Directly manage 5-8 thumbnail designers conducting weekly 1-on-1s focused on skill development and performance
  • Lead bi-weekly team design reviews with constructive feedback and best practice sharing
  • Build comprehensive onboarding programs and training materials for new designer hires
  • Create career development pathways with clear promotion criteria for design team members
  • Conduct performance reviews and manage accountability through the Clarify Instrument Coach Decide framework
  • Build 2-5+ year relationships with designers through proactive retention and engagement strategies
  • Conduct skip-level meetings with junior designers to assess team health and identify early warning signs

Creative Excellence & Standards (20-30% of role)

  • Design 15-30 high-impact thumbnails per month for VIP clients and complex projects
  • Own and evolve agency-wide creative quality standards, brand guidelines, and style guides
  • Establish QA processes that maintain 90%+ first-approval rate across all designers
  • Lead A/B testing strategy and performance analysis across the entire client portfolio
  • Serve as final creative approval for all thumbnails before client delivery
  • Drive creative innovation through monthly experimentation initiatives and "Good Flops"
  • Create and maintain design team's template library and asset management systems

Strategic Collaboration & Systems (10-20% of role)

  • Partner with Pod Managers on client strategy and creative direction for key accounts
  • Present creative strategy and performance insights in Monthly Client Strategy Calls with clients
  • Collaborate with executive leadership on agency-wide creative vision and initiatives
  • Build scalable workflows, capacity planning, and resource allocation systems
  • Create performance dashboards tracking team metrics (CTR, approval rates, turnaround times)
  • Document best practices, SOPs, and knowledge base for the design function
  • Contribute to quarterly planning, annual strategy summits, and company OKRs

REQUIREMENTS:

Leadership & Design Experience

  • 6+ years of professional design experience with2+ years managing creative teams
  • Proven track record leading, developing, and scaling design teams of 5+ people
  • Minimum3+ years creating high-performing YouTube thumbnails with proven CTR results
  • Experience hiring designers, conducting performance reviews, and managing accountability
  • Portfolio showcasing thumbnails that contributed to channel growth (include CTR data)
  • Comfortable with difficult conversations (performance issues, firing, conflict resolution)

Technical & Strategic Skills

  • Expert-level proficiency in Photoshop, Illustrator, and Figma (portfolio required)
  • Deep understanding of YouTube algorithms, CTR optimization, and viewer psychology
  • Data-driven approach with ability to interpret analytics and translate into design strategy
  • Experience with A/B testing methodologies, performance analysis, and optimization
  • Strong presentation skills for client-facing strategy calls and executive meetings
  • Understanding of creative team economics (capacity planning, resourcing, budgeting)
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication for feedback, presentations, and documentation
  • Demonstrated ability to give feedback that accelerates growth and elevates work quality
  • Extreme Ownership - Takes full accountability for team results; never blames or makes excuses
  • Beyond Excellence - Sets impossibly high standards and inspires team to exceed them
  • Proactive Curiosity - Anticipates problems, asks better questions, and stays ahead of needs
  • Mission Focus - Obsesses about client success and team development over personal recognition

RESULTS:

Team Performance

  • Your design team consistently maintains90%+ first-approval rate across all designers
  • Designer retention rate exceeds 85% annually with clear development and career progression
  • New designers productive at80% capacity within 30-60 days through your training systems
  • 100% of direct reports show measurable skill improvement quarter-over-quarter
  • Team operates at80-90% capacity utilization - productive output without burnout

Quality & Impact

  • Zero client escalations due to design quality issues or missed deadlines from your team
  • Agency-wide thumbnailCTR averages 5-10% (significantly above platform benchmarks)
  • 95%+ on-time delivery rate across your entire team's project portfolio
  • Design workflows, templates, and style guides documented and adopted agency-wide
  • Your team generates innovative thumbnail strategies that drive agency-wide adoption

Strategic Leadership

  • Design function viewed asstrategic partner by Pod Managers and leadership
  • Successfully contribute to client strategy with design insights that drive performance
  • Client satisfaction scores remain >4.5/5 for design quality and communication
  • At least1-2 designers promoted or advancement-ready annually due to your mentorship
  • Leadership views design as a strategic differentiator, not just an execution function

COMPENSATION & GROWTH:

Salary & Benefits

  • Starting Range: $42,000 - $72,000 USD/year depending on experience and team size managed
  • Fully Remote
  • Flexible Time Off policy & Company Wide Holiday Breaks (we trust you to manage your time and energy)
  • Professional development budget for courses, plugins, and creative tools
  • PotentialHealth Insurance Reimbursement (after 60-90 day trial period options including Medical, Dental, Vision)
  • Potential to earnMonthly wellness allowance
  • Potential to earnHome office stipend for equipment and software
  • Access to industry-leading tools, plugins, and AI-assisted editing software
  • Clear career progression with transparent promotion criteria

Performance Metrics You'll Own

  • Team Performance: Design Quality Score, First-Approval Rate (90%+), CTR performance
  • Team Development: Skill progression, promotion readiness, retention rate (85%+)
  • Operational Excellence: Capacity utilization (80-90%), on-time delivery (95%+)
  • Strategic Impact: Innovation initiatives, process improvements, client satisfaction (>4.5/5)

LOCATION:

  • 100% Remote

WHO WE ARE:

Knwn Local helps America's top real estate leaders (ranked by Wall Street Journal Real Trends) attract more clients and grow their brands through strategic YouTube presence. Our clients manage $30M-$300M+ real estate teams and brokerages.

We're scaling from 55+ to 200+ channels with the mission of helping agents dominate their local markets through long-form video content that builds trust and authority.

Our Core Values: Extreme Ownership, Beyond Excellence, Proactive Curiosity, Mission Focus

MAKE SURE YOU'RE COMFORTABLE WITH:

  • Remote team leadership (building culture and managing performance without in-person oversight)
  • Rigorous hiring process including portfolio review, leadership case study, design test, and interviews
  • 90-day paid trial period with clear success metrics and transparent evaluation
  • Player-coach expectations (10-30% IC work even as you grow the team)

  • Accountability culture (measured on results with clear metrics and transparent feedback)

description:
Descrição

Recepcionista | (Banco de Talentos)

Aqui, o primeiro sorriso começa com você! Na Odontoclinic, acreditamos que cada detalhe faz a diferença na jornada do paciente — e o primeiro encantamento começa na recepção. Se você ama gente, adora ouvir, acolher, cuidar e transformar um simples "bom dia" em uma experiência marcante, vem com a gente!

O Que Você Vai Encontrar Aqui

  • Um ambiente acolhedor, colaborativo, leve, humano, cheio de propósito e com alto astral
  • Treinamentos constantes e ferramentas para o seu desenvolvimento
  • Reconhecimento por desempenho e oportunidades reais de crescimento
  • Propósito: transformar a vida das pessoas através do sorriso!

Procuramos Alguém Com

  • Um sorriso no rosto e brilho no olhar
  • Comunicação leve, clara e acolhedora
  • Organização e agilidade no dia a dia
  • Vontade de crescer e aprender constantemente
  • Experiência com atendimento é um diferencial, mas encantar é essencial!

Suas Principais Missões

  • Receber nossos pacientes com empatia e atenção
  • Cuidar dos agendamentos, confirmações e atendimentos com carinho (presencial, telefone e WhatsApp)
  • Ser o elo de confiança entre o paciente e a equipe clínica
  • Organizar a recepção para que cada visita seja única e especial
  • Apoiar nas rotinas administrativas da clínica com leveza e responsabilidade
  • Abertura Clínica
  • Atualização de cadastros
  • Zelar pela organização e limpeza da recepção

Sobre a ODONTOCLINIC

Na Odontoclinic, somos movidos por pessoas e por sorrisos. Somos uma empresa feita de gente que gosta de gente. Aqui, acreditamos no poder da atitude, da ação e da paixão por encantar. Nosso time é formado por profissionais que não apenas vestem a camisa, mas têm atitude de dono, colocam a mão na massa e fazem acontecer todos os dias.

Com mais de 28 anos de história, construímos a maior rede de franquias odontológicas do Brasil. São mais de 180 clínicas em todo o país, mais de 1 milhão de sorrisos cuidados com carinho e cerca de 9 mil atendimentos realizados por dia. Tudo isso só é possível porque temos um time incrível por trás de cada resultado.

Somos a primeira rede de franquias odontológicas do país e, ao longo dos anos, colecionamos conquistas como o Troféu Excelência em Franchising da ABF e o reconhecimento como uma das Melhores Franquias do Brasil pela revista Pequenas Empresas & Grandes Negócios. Também fomos eleitos, por seis anos consecutivos, como a clínica com o melhor atendimento do Brasil no segmento odontológico pelo Reclame Aqui — um reflexo direto da nossa paixão por servir e do compromisso com a qualidade em cada detalhe.

Aqui, acreditamos que o desenvolvimento de pessoas é o caminho para construir resultados sustentáveis. Por isso, investimos constantemente em treinamentos, programas de capacitação e iniciativas que potencializam o crescimento pessoal e profissional dos nossos colaboradores. Acreditamos no poder da educação continuada como alicerce para inovação, performance e encantamento.

Na Odontoclinic, você encontra um ambiente acolhedor, diverso e cheio de oportunidades. Um lugar onde você pode ser quem é, crescer, aprender e deixar sua marca. Se você tem espírito empreendedor, gosta de desafios e quer fazer parte de algo grande, seu lugar é aqui. Vem ser Odontocliniquer!

  • Regime de contratação de tipo: Efetivo – CLT
  • Jornada: Período Integral
  • Nível hierárquico: Auxiliar

REQUISITOS

Escolaridade Mínima: Ensino Médio (2º Grau)

VALORIZADO

Tempo de experiência: Entre 1 e 3 anos

Seu DNA é Tech e seu talento é comercial? Venha ser um Consultor de Soluções em Tecnologia na SDE Distribuidora! Se você respira tecnologia, tem experiência em campo e o brilho nos olhos para prospectar e construir parcerias duradouras, seu lugar é com a gente. Nosso Consultor de Soluções em Tecnologia é o profissional estratégico que conecta a tecnologia às necessidades reais de nossos clientes. Sua missão vai além da venda de produtos, transformando o conhecimento técnico em soluções inovadoras e personalizadas em segurança eletrônica, redes, comunicação e energia. Você será o elo que impulsiona o crescimento mútuo e solidifica parcerias, contribuindo ativamente para a excelência da SDE no mercado.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Diagnosticar e propor soluções técnicas: Entender a fundo as necessidades dos clientes para desenhar e apresentar soluções completas e integradas em nosso portfólio (segurança eletrônica, redes, comunicação e energia), realizando demonstrações e prestando consultoria especializada.

  • Elaborar e negociar propostas de valor: Criar propostas comerciais e orçamentos detalhados e tecnicamente consistentes, negociando termos que gerem valor para o cliente e para a SDE, e otimizando o processo de vendas.
  • Manter-se atualizado e compartilhar conhecimento: Buscar constante aprimoramento sobre as tendências do mercado de tecnologia, produtos e normas técnicas, participando de treinamentos e certificações, e compartilhando esse conhecimento com a equipe e clientes.
  • Representar a SDE como referência técnica: Fortalecer a imagem da SDE em eventos do setor e assegurar a satisfação do cliente no pós-venda, buscando oportunidades de cross‑selling e up‑selling.

REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas consultivas ou técnicas no setor de tecnologia (distribuição, integração, instalação ou fabricantes de hardware/software).
  • Conhecimento técnico aprofundado em pelo menos uma das áreas de atuação da SDE:
    • Segurança Eletrônica: CFTV (analógico/IP), controle de acesso (biometria, RFID), alarmes, sistemas de monitoramento.
    • Redes e Comunicação: Redes estruturadas (cabeamento, switches, roteadores), Wi‑Fi, PABX IP.
    • Energia: Noções de energia solar fotovoltaica, no‑breaks, estabilizadores, sistemas de alimentação ininterrupta.
  • Habilidade para interpretar projetos técnicos e diagramas.
  • Experiência com CRM ou ferramentas de gestão de vendas.

REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS

Soft Skills

  • Curiosidade e Aprendizagem Contínua: Paixão por tecnologia e por se manter atualizado em um mercado dinâmico.
  • Pensamento Analítico: Habilidade para identificar problemas, analisar dados e propor soluções eficazes.
  • Comunicação Assertiva e Didática: Capacidade de explicar conceitos técnicos complexos de forma clara para diferentes públicos.
  • Proatividade e Autonomia: Iniciativa para buscar novas oportunidades e gerenciar sua carteira de forma independente.
  • Orientação para Resultados e Foco no Cliente: Impulso para superar metas, sempre com o cliente no centro das decisões.
  • Inteligência Emocional: Para lidar com desafios, negociações e construir relacionamentos.

Hard Skills Complementares

  • Certificações técnicas de fabricantes relevantes (ex: CFTV IP, redes Cisco/Ubiquiti, etc.).
  • Conhecimento em gestão de projetos.

FORMAÇÃO ACADÊMICA

  • Formação Acadêmica: Superior completo ou em andamento em cursos como Engenharia (Elétrica, Eletrônica, Telecomunicações, Controle e Automação), Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência da Computação, ou áreas afins.
  • Certificações: Certificações técnicas na área de segurança eletrônica, redes, ou energia solar serão consideradas um diferencial.

Experiência Profissional

  • Vendas técnicas ou consultivas em empresas de distribuição ou integração de tecnologia.
  • Instalação ou suporte técnico avançado em sistemas de segurança eletrônica, redes ou energia, com forte interface com clientes e/ou vendas.
  • Pré‑vendas técnicas ou engenharia de soluções.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

The Global Industry Leader for the Natural Resources and Energy sector is responsible for developing and delivering a strategic growth plan for the industry vertical. They build strong client relationships and lead business development initiatives. This role will be responsible for driving the successful implementation of the industry strategy across all client segments and regions, partnering with colleagues across business lines to harness broader Aon relationships to drive growth.

  • Develop and Implement Industry Growth Strategy: Define and implement a strategic plan to expand market share within the vertical, including identifying market opportunities and setting clear objectives.
  • Build and Maintain Client Relationships: Cultivate strong, trusted relationships with key client partners, their business challenges and proactively identifying ways the firm can add new value.
  • Lead Business Development Efforts: Drive regional pipeline generation and conversion by identifying and prioritizing new opportunities and supporting regional sales teams on large enterprise deals.
  • Deliver Thought Leadership: Represent the firm as an industry expert by publishing insights, speaking publicly at conferences, and participating in industry forums to raise Aon's profile and credibility.
  • Lead Financial Performance: Oversee the vertical’s financial health, including revenue targets, budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation.
  • Develop and Grow Industry-Focused Teams: Mentor, and develop talent with relevant industry expertise, fostering a collaborative and impactful team culture.
  • Collaborate Across the Organization: Work closely with other vertical leaders, service line leads, and regional leaders to harness broader firm capabilities and client relationships.
  • Monitor Industry Trends and Regulatory Changes: Stay abreast of industry developments, regulatory shifts, and emerging risks to ensure the firm’s offerings remain relevant and compliant.
  • Drive Innovation and Solution Development: Identify client needs and market gaps, leading the development of new services, solutions, and delivery models tailored to the vertical.
  • Lead Collaborator Communication: Provide regular updates to executive leadership and other interested parties on vertical performance, critical initiatives, and key challenges.

How this opportunity is different

As a thought leader and industry expert, you will represent the firm in the market, track industry trends, and drive the creation of innovative, industry relevant and client-focused solutions. This is a pivotal leadership position for a committed professional with deep industry and reward expertise and a passion for delivering value to clients.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • Ten plus years of experience in compensation.

  • Fluency in the English language.
  • Deep understanding of Human Capital universe and needs of clients across all segments, with strengths across Rewards and Analytics.
  • Hands‑on experience of shaping and executing against a client‑focused vision.
  • Proven track record of building go‑to‑market strategies and driving sustained results over both a short and long‑term horizon.
  • Ability to lead strategic thinking around innovation and ideation with a strong client and commercial lens.
  • Exceptional communication skills to convey compelling messages across all levels and geographies.
  • Ability to work in a matrixed environment and lead through influence.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in relevant discipline or equivalent years of industry experience.

How we support our colleagues

In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage a diverse workforce. Plus, our agile, inclusive environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions, but we also recognise that flexibility goes beyond just the place of work... and we are all for it. We call this Smart Working!

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

title: Financial & Controlling Analyst / Senior Financial & Controlling Analyst
description:
About InPlanet

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scalingEnhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold:to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people-first care andperformance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page here

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure accurate and timely accounting and tax records following Brazilian GAAP and IFRS
  • Support financial consolidation across multiple entities and geographies
  • Drive or support the month-end and year-end closing processes
  • Support the Finance team in corporate finance, strategy, and investor relations
  • Ensure strong internal controls and help mitigate financial and operational risks
  • Coordinate compliance with local and international tax and accounting standards
  • Support treasury operations , including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), and cash flow planning
  • Partner with FP&A to align operational and financial insights
  • Manage with external auditors and advisors during audits and reviews
  • Identify and lead process improvements to make our systems more reliable, efficient, and scalable

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust : You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes
  • Drive : You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field
  • 3-5 years of proven experience in controlling, accounting, or financial reporting roles
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian accounting standards , IFRS , and multi-entity consolidation
  • Strong command of Excel/Google Sheets and experience with financial systems
  • Familiarity with Accounting, Compliance, Treasury (AP & AR) , and FP&A
  • Advanced English communication skills
  • Excellent organizational and project management abilities
  • Collaborative, proactive, curious, and eager to learn
  • Goes above and beyond with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Hard-working and hands-on
  • Detail-oriented and analytical, with a problem-solving mindset
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in a dynamic environment

Bonus Points (but not essential)

  • Experience in a Big 4 or audit firm
  • Experience in financial modeling and valuation
  • Proven track record in building or improving accounting and tax processes in cross-border or fast-growing companies
  • Previous experience in climate tech, sustainability, or international startup settings

Benefits

  • Compensation expectations and our comp philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly.
  • Home Office Budget
  • Fully Remote: (Brazil-based).
  • Personal development budget
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 40 days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.
  • Occasional off-sites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

About the Role

We’re looking for aFinancial & Controlling Analyst / Senior Financial & Controlling Analyst to join our Finance team and strengthen the foundation that supports InPlanet’s growth and impact. You’ll take care ofAccounting & Tax, Financial Reporting, Internal Controls, and Risk Management , ensuring that our operations remain solid, compliant, and ready to scale globally. You\'ll be the kind of person who enjoys both getting things done and thinking strategically - structured, purpose-driven, and comfortable switching between hands-on tasks and higher-level discussions. The Impact you can make
Your work will make a real difference in how we grow — helping InPlanet stay financially healthy, transparent, and ready to make decisions that accelerate our mission of removing CO₂ from the atmosphere. You’ll help build and improve the processes that keep our numbers reliable and our teams confident in their decisions.
Core working relationships
You’ll collaborate closely with:

  • Our Finance Leadership
  • Operations, People, and Science teams
  • External accounting and tax partners

InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate. The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach. These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency.

title: Analista de Suporte N2 – Redes
description:
Analista N2 Pleno

Empresa

Somos um provedor de internet em crescimento, focado em qualidade, estabilidade e atendimento próximo aos nossos clientes.

Missão do cargo

Garantir que a rede funcione de forma estável, resolvendo problemas técnicos de clientes e da infraestrutura, atuando entre o atendimento N1 e a engenharia/N3.

Atividades principais

  • Atender chamados escalados pelo N1 (casos que o N1 não conseguiu resolver).
  • Analisar conectividade:
    • Testes de ping e traceroute (IP e domínio).
    • Identificar se o problema está no cliente, na rede interna, no POP, na rota ou na operadora.
  • Acessar e analisar OLT GPON (ZTE, Huawei, Fiberhome, Nokia ou similar):
    • Ver potência RX/TX das ONUs.
    • Ver ONUs flutuando (online/offline).
    • Verificar erros e utilização das portas GPON.
  • Verificar e ajustar VLAN, PPPoE, IPoE e DHCP:
    • Sessões PPPoE travadas.
    • Cliente autenticando e não navegando.
    • Cliente sem IP ou recebendo IP incorreto.
  • Apoiar o time de campo com diagnóstico técnico (indicar provável ponto de falha).
  • Utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento (Zabbix, Grafana ou similares) para identificar e prevenir instabilidades.
  • Registrar nos chamados o passo a passo do diagnóstico e da solução.

Requisitos técnicos (obrigatórios)

  • Experiência prévia em provedor de internet ou suporte de redes.
  • Bom conhecimento de TCP/IP (IP, máscara, gateway, DNS, rota).
  • Entender bem PPPoE e/ou IPoE.
  • Saber trabalhar com VLAN (ACCESS/TRUNK, tagged/untagged).
  • Noções sólidas de IPv4 e NAT.
  • Uso prático de ping, tracert/traceroute e testes por IP e domínio.
  • Conhecimento básico em ao menos um equipamento de borda, por exemplo: Mikrotik, Cisco, Huawei ou similar.
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de logs (roteador, OLT, servidor PPPoE/DHCP).

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios, mas contam ponto)

  • Experiência com OLT GPON (ZTE, Huawei, Fiberhome, Nokia, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de CGNAT / BNG / BRAS.
  • Experiência com Zabbix, Grafana ou outras ferramentas de monitoramento.
  • Noções de IPv6.
  • Cursos ou certificações em redes (MTCNA, CCNA, etc.).
  • Já trabalhou em provedor de internet.
  • Sabe mexer em OLT GPON na prática (ver potência, ONU, porta, erros).
  • Usa Mikrotik ou similar no dia a dia.
  • Consegue resolver a maioria dos problemas sem supervisão.
  • Já trabalhou com redes/provedor.
  • Conce sabe TCP/IP, PPPoE, VLAN.
  • Atua com OLT GPON + Mikrotik + monitoramento (Zabbix/Grafana).
  • Entende bem PPPoE, IPoE, VLAN, NAT, CGNAT/BNG.
  • Consegue segurar plantão e dar suporte ao time como referência técnica.

Perfil comportamental

  • Gosta de resolver problema até o fim, sem “empurrar para o outro”.
  • Sabe trabalhar sob pressão, mantendo calma e foco.
  • Boa comunicação com N1, N3 e técnicos de campo.
  • Organização para registrar tudo o que faz.
  • Vontade de aprender e crescer junto com a empresa.

  • Horário: segunda a sexta, das 09h às 17h
  • Sábado, das 09h às 13h
  • Local: Av Ayrton Senna 3000, Edíficio Itanhanga (Via Parque) – Presencial

title: Brazil - Remote: Data Engineer - Platform & Pipelines
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are implementing a strict Medallion Architecture to organize petabytes of industrial data. This role is for a Data Engineer who excels at transforming raw chaos into structured, queryable assets.

You will build and maintain the ELT pipelines that move data from "Bronze" (Raw) to "Silver" (Cleaned) and "Gold" (Aggregated). You will work with Delta Lake (On-prem/Databricks ), Polars and Airflow to ensure data quality and availability for Data Scientists and the Knowledge Graph.

  • Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.
  • Data Transformation: Use Spark (when scale requires) and Polars to clean, enrich, and aggregate data according to business logic.
  • Architecture Implementation: Enforce the Medallion Architecture patterns, ensuring clear separation of concerns between data layers.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time; make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
  • Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.
  • Data Quality: Implement comprehensive data validation checks and quality gates between medallion layers.
  • Data Cataloging: Maintain the metadata and catalog entries to ensure all data assets are discoverable and documented.

The Technology Stack

  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow.
  • Data Processing: Polars (primary for ETL), PySpark/SQL (for massive scale)
  • Compute: Single-node workers (Polars), Databricks/Spark clusters (when scale requires)
  • Storage: Delta Lake, Parquet, S3/Blob Storage, MinIO
  • Language: Python 3.12+ (w/ Polars), SQL.

Qualifications

  • The Structured Thinker: You love organizing data. You understand the importance of schemas, data typing, and normalization.
  • Quality Obsessive: You don\'t just move data; you test it. You implement checks to ensure no bad data reaches the Gold layer.
  • Pipeline Builder: You view data engineering as software engineering. You write modular, reusable code for your transformations.

Must Haves

  • Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
    • Complete Bachelor\'s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
    • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering.
    • Strong proficiency in Apache Airflow and Databricks.
    • Experience implementing Medallion/Delta Lake architectures.
    • Strong SQL and Python skills.
    • Advanced English communication skills.

Good To Have

  • Experience with Unity Catalog or other governance tools.
  • Familiarity with dbt (data build tool).
  • Background in processing telemetry or sensor data.
